Your one job

Reduce missed leads and manual effort without creating fragile systems.

01

Do this now

  1. 01

    Identify the highest-frequency recurring bottleneck and estimate real time/money lost.

  2. 02

    Document the trigger, action, owner, failure conditions and manual fallback.

  3. 03

    Prefer built-in software features or simple rules before AI or elaborate automation platforms.

  4. 04

    Test duplicates, bad input, timeouts and human escalation before enabling automation for every customer.

02

Copy this into ChatGPT

Replace anything in [square brackets] with your real business details. The prompt is a shortcut, not a substitute for the steps above.

READY-TO-USE PROMPT
Evaluate whether [WORKFLOW] should remain manual, use an existing software feature, be automated with a simple rule or require AI. Compare implementation effort, ongoing costs, risk, customer consequences and maintenance. Then give a test plan including failures, duplicates, permissions and a manual fallback.
03

Finish with this

One mapped and tested workflow with an owner, alert and fallback.

Before moving on, check your work against the following:

  • The problem is measured
  • Fallback exists
  • Customer-facing failures tested
DON’T MAKE THIS MISTAKE

Using AI because it is fashionable when a simple checklist is better.

READY TO MOVE ON?

A repeatable profitable process exists and the next investment is supported by measured results.
